title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
title_zh: VAE潜在空间中的色彩对齐及其应用

paragraphs.en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning , which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control , to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer , to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/

paragraphs.en: Natural images are far from random: they occupy a small, highly structured subset of the space of all possible pixel arrays, with strong spatial and spectral correlations ( Simoncelli & Olshausen, 2001 ) . Efficient coding theory holds that a visual system should exploit this redundancy by mapping its inputs to a compact, decorrelated representation ( Barlow, 1961 ; Malo, 2020 ) . For color, this principle gives a remarkably consistent answer: decorrelating the cone responses to natural scenes yields one achromatic luminance axis and two chromatic opponent axes, namely red–green and blue–yellow ( Buchsbaum & Gottschalk, 1983 ; Ruderman et al., 1998 ) . These axes closely match the cardinal directions of early human color vision ( Derrington et al., 1984 ) and are mirrored in perceptual color spaces such as CIELAB. Luminance and opponent colors are therefore not an arbitrary convention but a property of natural images, one that any efficient encoder should be expected to recover.
paragraphs.zh: 自然图像远非随机：它们仅占据所有可能像素数组空间中的一个小型且高度结构化的子集，并表现出强烈的空间与光谱相关性（Simoncelli & Olshausen, 2001）。 高效编码理论认为，视觉系统应利用这种冗余性，将其输入映射为一个紧凑且去相关化的表示形式（Barlow, 1961；Malo, 2020）。 对于颜色而言，这一原则给出了一个高度一致的答案：对自然场景的锥体响应进行去相关化处理后，会得到一条非彩色的亮度轴和两条彩色对立轴，即红-绿轴与蓝-黄轴（Buchsbaum & Gottschalk, 1983；Ruderman et al., 1998）。 这些轴与早期人类视觉中的主要颜色方向高度吻合（Derrington et al., 1984），并在 CIELAB 等感知色彩空间中得到了体现。 因此，亮度与对立色并非人为设定的约定，而是自然图像的一种属性，任何高效的编码器都应能够恢复这一属性。

paragraphs.en: In fact, the evidence suggests that artificial systems trained on natural images develop this color representation too. Unsupervised methods related to independent component analysis, applied to color image patches, learn separate achromatic and color-opponent features ( Hoyer & Hyvärinen, 2000 ; Gutmann et al., 2014 ) . Deep networks behave similarly: the first-layer of CNNs trained for classification display achromatic and color-opponent units ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ; Flachot & Gegenfurtner, 2018 ) , and CNNs trained for low-level vision tasks show human-like color axes and behavior, including susceptibility to color illusions ( Gomez-Villa et al., 2020 ) , and distinctive spatial bandwidth for color channels ( Li et al., 2022 ) . Finally, vision foundation models, trained on natural images at a far larger scale, may therefore retain this color structure, and recent evidence supports this expectation ( Akbarinia, 2025 ; Wickramanayaka & Oizumi, 2025 ; Gomez-Villa et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 事实上，证据表明，在自然图像上进行训练的人工系统也会发展出这种颜色表示方式。 与独立成分分析相关的无监督方法应用于彩色图像块时，能够学习出独立的无彩特征和颜色对立特征（Hoyer & Hyvärinen, 2000；Gutmann et al., 2014）。 深度网络的行为也类似：用于分类训练的CNN第一层会表现出无彩单元和颜色对立单元（Krizhevsky et al., 2012；Flachot & Gegenfurtner, 2018），而用于低层次视觉任务训练的CNN则展现出类人的颜色轴和行为，包括对颜色错觉的易感性（Gomez-Villa et al., 2020）以及颜色通道特有的空间带宽（Li et al., 2022）。 最后，在自然图像上进行大规模训练的视觉基础模型因此可能保留这种颜色结构，而近期的证据也支持这一预期（Akbarinia, 2025；Wickramanayaka & Oizumi, 2025；Gomez-Villa et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Most modern text-to-image models are latent generators: rather than operating on pixels, they generate within the representation learned by a VAE and decode the result back to image space ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . VAEs are known to organize this representation around the factors of variation in the data: they tend to disentangle generative attributes ( Higgins et al., 2017 ; Burgess et al., 2018 ) and to align their latent axes with the principal directions of the data ( Rolinek et al., 2019 ; Zietlow et al., 2021 ) . Yet, although color is one of the most thoroughly studied and highly structured properties of natural images, how it is represented in these latent spaces has only recently begun to be explored ( Arias et al., 2025 ; Pach et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, text-to-image models still fail to bind colors to objects, render named colors faithfully, or follow numerical specifications such as HEX or RGB codes ( Butt et al., 2026a ) . The color structure may already be present in the latent space; but the generators simply do not use it.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数现代文本到图像模型都是潜在生成器：它们并非直接操作像素，而是在变分自编码器（VAE）所学习的表示空间内进行生成，再将结果解码回图像空间（Rombach 等，2022）。 已知 VAE 会围绕数据中的变化因素来组织这种表示：它们倾向于解耦生成属性（Higgins 等，2017；Burgess 等，2018），并使其潜在轴与数据的主要方向对齐（Rolinek 等，2019；Zietlow 等，2021）。 然而，尽管颜色是自然图像中研究最透彻且高度结构化的属性之一，但它在这些潜在空间中的表示方式直到最近才开始被探索（Arias 等，2025；Pach 等，2026）。 与此同时，文本到图像模型仍然无法将颜色与物体关联起来，无法忠实地呈现命名颜色，也无法遵循 HEX 或 RGB 代码等数值规格（Butt 等，2026a）。 颜色结构可能已经存在于潜在空间中；但生成器根本没有利用它。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have begun to probe color in these latent spaces with uniform images, recovering opponent hue axes in the Stable Diffusion VAE ( Arias et al., 2025 ) and an HSL-like subspace in the FLUX VAE ( Pach et al., 2026 ) . Such inputs reveal where colors are mapped, but not how color is encoded alongside the spatial content of real images. We instead analyze the response to natural images and show that the VAEs of modern text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-color directions (Fig. 1 ). On the encoder side, the singular vectors of a linear approximation of the encoder are achromatic and opponent-color patterns; on the decoder side, traversing individual latent channels shifts the color of the decoded image. We find this structure consistently in the VAEs of SD1.5, SDXL, SD3, FLUX, and FLUX.2, with 4 to 32 latent channels, and show that it is only partially disentangled from image structure. Building on it, we propose ColorTuning , which steers generation to follow numerical color specifications and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench (81.20% vs. 51.96%), and show that the same color basis also enables saturation control and color transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的研究开始使用均匀图像来探索这些潜在空间中的颜色，在 Stable Diffusion VAE 中恢复了拮抗色轴（Arias et al., 2025），并在 FLUX VAE 中发现了一个类似 HSL 的子空间（Pach et al., 2026）。 这类输入揭示了颜色被映射的位置，但并未说明颜色是如何与真实图像的空间内容一同编码的。 我们转而分析模型对自然图像的响应，并证明现代文本到图像模型的 VAE 共享一个与亮度和拮抗色方向对齐的颜色子空间（图 1）。 在编码器端，编码器线性近似的奇异向量是无彩色和拮抗色模式；在解码器端，遍历单个潜在通道会改变解码后图像的颜色。 我们在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3、FLUX 和 FLUX.2 的 VAE 中（潜在通道数为 4 到 32）都一致发现了这种结构，并证明它与图像结构仅部分解耦。 基于此，我们提出了 ColorTuning，该技术能够引导生成过程遵循数值化的颜色规范，在 GenColorBench 的 CSS3/X11 系统上实现了当前最高的准确率（81.20% vs. 51.96%），并证明了相同的颜色基础也支持饱和度控制和颜色迁移。

paragraphs.en: What VAEs disentangle. Unsupervised disentanglement is impossible without inductive biases on both model and data ( Locatello et al., 2019 ) , yet VAEs often disentangle in practice ( Higgins et al., 2017 ; Burgess et al., 2018 ) . Rolinek et al. (2019) traced this to the diagonal posterior, which aligns the latent axes with the local principal directions of the data, and Zietlow et al. (2021) showed that this yields disentanglement only when the variance structure of the data matches its generative factors. This line of work has been evaluated almost exclusively on synthetic benchmarks. We test it on color, whose natural-image statistics decorrelate into one luminance and two opponent axes ( Buchsbaum & Gottschalk, 1983 ; Ruderman et al., 1998 ) .

paragraphs.en: Precise color control. Existing methods either act on the text conditioning, by learning color tokens ( Butt et al., 2024 ) or grounding HEX codes and RGB values in a CIELAB-aligned ColorBook (NumColor; Butt et al., 2026b ), or intervene at inference time, either by rewiring cross-attention (ColorWave; Laria et al., 2026 ) or by optimizing the latents ( Shomer-Chai et al., 2026 ) . We observe this across deterministic autoencoders (AEs), VAEs, and VQ-VAEs with 3, 4, 8, and 32 channels trained from scratch, as well as in the pretrained VAEs of SD1.5, SDXL, SD3, FLUX, and FLUX.2 (See the Fig. 2 and Appendix A.3 ). paragraphs.zh: 由于这些潜在变量具有空间性，我们将每个潜在维度称为一个通道，并在解码前，通过在每个空间位置添加一个常数偏移量 δ \delta（即 z c → z c + δ z_{c}\to z_{c}+\delta ）来遍历通道 c。 如图 2 所示，逐步修改 δ \delta 会使解码后的图像颜色沿一个一致的方向发生偏移。 我们在从头训练的确定性自编码器（AE）、VAE 和 VQ-VAE（分别具有 3、4、8 和 32 个通道）中观察到了这一现象，同时也在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3、FLUX 和 FLUX.2 的预训练 VAE 中观察到了类似情况（参见图 2 和附录 A.3）。 因此，无需任何学习到的探测机制，即可直接从原始潜在通道中读取颜色信息。

paragraphs.en: Color is, however, spatio-chromatically entangled: the same channels that carry color also carry spatial information. For small offsets, traversing the channel modifies only the color of the decoded image; but beyond a certain magnitude, it also begins to alter its spatial content. This behavior is visible in the edges and textures in the outermost columns of Fig. 2 (see Appendix A.3 for more examples). We quantify this in Fig. 3 as a function of δ \delta . We measure color change with Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} (CIEDE2000) relative to the unperturbed reconstruction, and spatial change with MS-SSIM computed on grayscale images using only its contrast and structure terms, so that the intended color and brightness shifts are not penalized. As | δ | |\delta| increases, Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} grows steadily, while MS-SSIM stays close to 1 for small offsets and then drops. Color can therefore be edited by moving along the latent channels, but only within a limited range before the edit starts to change the spatial content of the image.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，颜色在空间-色彩维度上是纠缠的：传递颜色的同一通道也传递着空间信息。 对于较小的偏移量，遍历该通道只会修改解码后图像的颜色；但一旦超过某个幅度，它也会开始改变图像的空间内容。 这种行为可见于图 2 最外列的边缘和纹理中（更多示例请参见附录 A.3）。 我们在图 3 中将其量化为 δ \delta 的函数。 我们通过 Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00}（CIEDE2000）来测量相对于未受扰动重建图像的颜色变化，并通过仅使用灰度图像的对比度和结构项计算 MS-SSIM 来测量空间变化，这样就不会对预期的颜色和亮度变化进行惩罚。 随着 | δ | |\delta| 的增加，Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} 会稳定增长，而 MS-SSIM 在偏移量较小时接近 1，随后则会下降。 因此，可以通过沿潜在通道移动来编辑颜色，但只能在有限范围内操作，否则编辑就会开始改变图像的空间内容。

paragraphs.en: In general, we find that individual channels do not uniquely map one-to-one onto specific colors: a single channel typically moves the image along a mixture of them, and several channels can move it in similar directions (e.g., two different channels may both turn the image green). A notable exception arises when there are only 3 latent channels. In this case, both the VAE and the AE align closely with the opponent color space: one channel controls brightness, and the other two control the opponent axes (see Appendix A.3 ). For the VAE, this is the behavior predicted by Rolinek et al. (2019) . For the AE, it is not: its objective has no mechanism that favors a particular orientation ( Rolinek et al., 2019 ) . However, opponent color directions do appear in plain autoencoders ( Gomez-Villa et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2022 ) , and, as shown below, they consistently emerge in modern autoencoders.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们发现各个通道并不会唯一地一对一映射到特定颜色：单个通道通常会沿着多种颜色的混合方向移动图像，而多个通道也可能以相似的方向移动图像（例如，两个不同的通道都可能会使图像变绿）。 当仅存在 3 个潜在通道时，会出现一个值得注意的例外情况。 在这种情况下，VAE 和 AE 都与对立色空间高度一致：一个通道控制亮度，另外两个通道则控制对立轴（参见附录 A.3）。 对于 VAE 而言，这是 Rolinek 等人（2019）所预测的行为。 但对于 AE 而言则并非如此：其目标函数中没有任何机制会偏好某种特定的方向（Rolinek 等人，2019）。 然而，对立色方向确实出现在普通的自编码器中（Gomez-Villa 等人，2020；Li 等人，2022），并且如下文所示，它们在现代自编码器中也始终会出现。

paragraphs.en: In the general case, where color is spread across correlated channels, the color subspace can still be recovered with a PCA decomposition of the channels’ color responses, which yields one luminance and two opponent-color directions. paragraphs.zh: 在一般情况下，当颜色分布在相互关联的通道中时，通过对这些通道的颜色响应进行主成分分析（PCA）分解，仍然可以恢复出颜色子空间，从而得到一个亮度分量和两个对立色方向。 这正是我们在应用（第 4 节）中所利用的机制。

paragraphs.en: The traversals in section 3.1 show that color is readable from the latent channels, but not why. To answer this we turn to the input side and ask which image patterns the encoder is most sensitive to. Because a VAE is trained to reconstruct its input, its response stays close to the identity and is well described to first order, which lets us replace the encoder by a matrix whose singular vectors are precisely those patterns, ordered by how strongly they drive the latent. If the color structure observed above originates in the encoder, it should appear here as achromatic and opponent-color patterns among the leading singular vectors.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.1 节中的遍历表明，颜色可以从潜在通道中读取，但并未解释其原理。 为了解答这个问题，我们转向输入端，探究编码器对哪些图像模式最为敏感。 由于 VAE 的训练目标是重建其输入，因此其响应会保持与恒等映射相近，并且可以用一阶近似很好地描述；这使得我们可以用一种矩阵来替代编码器，该矩阵的奇异向量恰好就是这些模式，并按它们驱动潜在变量的强度进行排序。 如果上文观察到的颜色结构源于编码器，那么它应该在这里表现为非彩色的、对立颜色的模式，并出现在主要的奇异向量中。

paragraphs.en: Sec. 3 shows that VAE latents carry a color structure inherited from natural image statistics, but spread across correlated channels and only partially disentangled from spatial content. paragraphs.en: Our approach is based on two key properties of the discovered color directions. First, diffusion and flow-matching models resolve low spatial frequencies first Biroli et al. (2024) : the coarse color of a region is settled well before sampling ends, so decoding the predicted clean latent z ^ 0 \hat{z}_{0} (Eq. 2 in Appendix 2.1 ) at an intermediate step already reveals the color the object will have in the final image. Second, the characterization of Sec. 4.1 gives the directions along which that color can be moved. Measuring the current color and applying the corresponding displacement over the remaining steps is therefore enough to reach the target (see Fig. 16 in Appendix A.7 ).

paragraphs.en: Training. The basis of Sec. 4.1 fixes the directions, but not the magnitude: how far a given displacement moves the object in CIELAB depends on the color it starts from, since the decoder is nonlinear. We therefore learn this relation empirically. For a set of prompts containing a color name, we generate one image without intervention and, for each displacement m ∈ ℳ m\in\mathcal{M} along the basis, a second image with the perturbation applied to the target object. Measuring the color of the object in both images gives a triplet: the color before the perturbation, the color it reached, and the displacement that produced it. On this data we train a small MLP that takes an initial and a target color, C i = ( L i , a i , b i ) C_{i}=(L_{i},a_{i},b_{i}) and C t = ( L t , a t , b t ) C_{t}=(L_{t},a_{t},b_{t}) , and predicts the displacement ( m 1 , m 2 , m 3 ) (m_{1},m_{2},m_{3}) along the basis that carries C i C_{i} to C t C_{t} (Alg. 1 ).

paragraphs.en: Inference. The prompt still has to place the object in the scene, so we never pass the numerical code to the text encoder. We replace it with a proxy color name: the nearest entry in ISCC-NBS Level 2 to the requested value, measured in CIELAB. A prompt such as “a car of color #7B3F00 ” becomes “a brown car” . The generator renders names far more reliably than codes, so the trajectory starts in the neighborhood of the target color and the steering only has to cover the residual difference. At a gate step s s , we predict the clean latent z ^ 0 \hat{z}_{0} (Eq. 2 ), decode it, locate the object with SAM 3 and measure its mean color in CIELAB. The MLP maps this color and the target to a displacement along the color basis, which we add to the latent inside the object mask at each remaining step, with a weight that decays linearly to zero so that the final steps re-integrate the perturbation into the image structure (Alg. 2 ; hyperparameters in Appendix A.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 推理。 提示词仍然需要将物体置于场景中，因此我们从不将数值代码传入文本编码器。 我们用代理颜色名称替代它：在 CIELAB 空间中，与所需值最接近的 ISCC-NBS 第 2 级条目。 例如，“一辆颜色为 #7B3F00 的汽车”这样的提示词会变成“一辆棕色的汽车”。 生成器渲染颜色名称远比渲染代码更可靠，因此轨迹从目标颜色的邻域开始，而调整只需覆盖剩余差异即可。 在门控步 s_s 处，我们预测干净的潜在变量 z^0（方程 2），对其进行解码，使用 SAM 3 定位物体，并测量其在 CIELAB 空间中的平均颜色。 多层感知器（MLP）将此颜色和目标映射到沿颜色基底的位移上，我们在每个剩余步骤中将该位移加到物体掩码内的潜在变量上，其权重线性衰减至零，以便在最后几步中将扰动重新整合到图像结构中（算法 2；超参数见附录 A.7）。

sents.en: Inference.
sents.zh: 推理。

sents.en: The prompt still has to place the object in the scene, so we never pass the numerical code to the text encoder.
sents.zh: 提示词仍然需要将物体置于场景中，因此我们从不将数值代码传入文本编码器。

sents.en: We replace it with a proxy color name: the nearest entry in ISCC-NBS Level 2 to the requested value, measured in CIELAB.
sents.zh: 我们用代理颜色名称替代它：在 CIELAB 空间中，与所需值最接近的 ISCC-NBS 第 2 级条目。

sents.en: A prompt such as “a car of color #7B3F00 ” becomes “a brown car” .
sents.zh: 例如，“一辆颜色为 #7B3F00 的汽车”这样的提示词会变成“一辆棕色的汽车”。

sents.en: The generator renders names far more reliably than codes, so the trajectory starts in the neighborhood of the target color and the steering only has to cover the residual difference.
sents.zh: 生成器渲染颜色名称远比渲染代码更可靠，因此轨迹从目标颜色的邻域开始，而调整只需覆盖剩余差异即可。

sents.en: At a gate step s s , we predict the clean latent z ^ 0 \hat{z}_{0} (Eq. 2 ), decode it, locate the object with SAM 3 and measure its mean color in CIELAB.
sents.zh: 在门控步 s_s 处，我们预测干净的潜在变量 z^0（方程 2），对其进行解码，使用 SAM 3 定位物体，并测量其在 CIELAB 空间中的平均颜色。

sents.en: The MLP maps this color and the target to a displacement along the color basis, which we add to the latent inside the object mask at each remaining step, with a weight that decays linearly to zero so that the final steps re-integrate the perturbation into the image structure (Alg. 2 ; hyperparameters in Appendix A.7 ).
sents.zh: 多层感知器（MLP）将此颜色和目标映射到沿颜色基底的位移上，我们在每个剩余步骤中将该位移加到物体掩码内的潜在变量上，其权重线性衰减至零，以便在最后几步中将扰动重新整合到图像结构中（算法 2；超参数见附录 A.7）。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We evaluate ColorTuning on GenColorBench ( Butt et al., 2026a ) , a benchmark for precise color generation in which prompts specify object colors as HEX codes and RGB values. We report accuracy on its two color systems, ISCC-L3 and CSS3/X11, under both formats. We apply ColorTuning to six generators covering the three latent sizes analyzed in Sec. 3 : SDXL (4 channels), SD3, SD3.5M, FLUX and Z-Image (16), and FLUX.2 (32). We compare against the vanilla models and against two color-control methods, each on the backbones for which it is available: ColorWave on SDXL and NumColor on SD3, SD3.5M and FLUX.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results. On the full benchmark (Table 1(b) ), vanilla models stay below 8% on both systems. On CSS3/X11, NumColor reaches 47–52%, while ColorTuning achieves the best accuracy on every backbone, up to 81.20% on FLUX. This is remarkable because, while NumColor remains ahead on ISCC-L3, the CSS3/X11 on which ColorTuning dominates is the one on which every model evaluated in GenColorBench performs worst ( Butt et al., 2026a ) . On the mini subset (Table 1(a) ), ColorTuning brings FLUX.2 and Z-Image to about 81% on CSS3/X11 and more than doubles ColorWave on SDXL (63.97% vs. 28.05%). A 2AFC user study with 22 observers with normal color vision confirms these gains perceptually: ColorTuning is preferred over both NumColor (FLUX) and ColorWave (SDXL), with z-scores (computed using Thurstone’s model) of 2.62 ± 0.30 2.62\pm 0.30 and 1.67 ± 0.30 1.67\pm 0.30 , respectively (95% CI; 0 indicates no preference). Details are in Appendix A.9 .

paragraphs.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 5 presents qualitative results obtained by applying ColorTuning to FLUX.2. The first two rows illustrate the method’s behavior across the full color spectrum, showing that the same concept can be rendered in substantially different hues while preserving its structure and appearance. The third and fourth rows evaluate fine-grained numerical color control, where target colors differ only subtly. The final two rows focus on pastel colors, which combine high luminance with low saturation and are particularly challenging for contemporary generative models. paragraphs.en: We have shown that color structure is already present in the raw latents of autoencoders trained on natural images: in AEs, VAEs, and VQ-VAEs alike, traversing a single latent channel shifts the color of the decoded image. This observation can be explained by a linear approximation of the encoder, whose leading singular vectors correspond to the achromatic and opponent-color patterns predicted by natural image statistics. Recovering these axes as an explicit basis turns the observation into a tool for color control during generation. Our main use of it is ColorTuning , which achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench; saturation control and color transfer further show, qualitatively, that the same basis supports other forms of color control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经证明，颜色结构在训练于自然图像的自编码器的原始潜在变量中就已经存在：无论是自编码器（AE）、变分自编码器（VAE）还是变分量子自编码器（VQ-VAE），只要遍历单个潜在变量通道，解码后的图像颜色就会发生变化。 这一观察结果可以通过对编码器进行线性近似来解释，其主导奇异向量对应于自然图像统计所预测的无彩度和对立色模式。 将这些轴作为显式基矢恢复出来，使这一观察结果成为生成过程中控制颜色的工具。 我们的主要应用是 ColorTuning，它在 GenColorBench 的精细 CSS3/X11 系统上实现了数值颜色生成的当前最高准确率；饱和度控制和颜色迁移则进一步从定性角度表明，同一基矢也支持其他形式的颜色控制。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods for encouraging precise color synthesis in generative models typically rely on learning new concepts that enforce specific color relationships. In contrast, our approach leverages the inherent color alignment already present in the VAE latent space to dynamically guide the generation process. However, this strategy remains sensitive to large steering magnitudes. As shown in our analysis, the extracted latent color channels are not fully disentangled from spatial and structural features. Consequently, when the MLP predicts a large displacement from the source color toward the target one, the resulting latent perturbation affects not only color but also image content, leading to structural distortions in the final output.
paragraphs.zh: 现有促进生成模型精确色彩合成的方法通常依赖于学习能够强制执行特定色彩关系的新概念。 相比之下，我们的方法利用了 VAE 潜在空间中已存在的内在色彩对齐机制，以动态引导生成过程。 然而，这种策略仍然对较大的引导幅度较为敏感。 正如我们的分析所示，提取出的潜在色彩通道并未完全从空间特征和结构特征中解耦。 因此，当 MLP 预测从源颜色到目标颜色的较大位移时，由此产生的潜在扰动不仅会影响色彩，还会影响图像内容，从而导致最终输出出现结构失真。

paragraphs.en: Whether a VAE recovers the true factors of variation in its data is a question of identifiability. Locatello et al. (2019) showed that unsupervised disentanglement is impossible without inductive biases on both model and data, and identifiability has since been proven only under additional assumptions such as auxiliary variables ( Khemakhem et al., 2020 ) . Yet VAEs often disentangle in practice ( Higgins et al., 2017 ; Burgess et al., 2018 ) . Rolinek et al. (2019) traced this to the diagonal posterior, which makes the decoder Jacobian locally orthogonal and aligns the latent axes with the local principal directions of the data. Relatedly, Reizinger et al. (2022) connected the ELBO to independent mechanism analysis in the near-deterministic regime. Zietlow et al. (2021) further showed that this bias yields disentanglement only when the variance structure of the dataset matches its generative factors. What a VAE disentangles is therefore dictated by the principal directions of its training data.
paragraphs.zh: 变分自编码器（VAE）能否恢复数据中的真实变化因子，是一个可识别性的问题。Locatello 等人 （2019）指出，若模型和数据本身没有归纳偏置，则无监督的解纠缠是不可能的；此后，可识别性仅在引入辅助变量等额外假设的情况下才得以证明（Khemakhem 等人，2020）。 然而，VAE 在实践中常常能实现解纠缠（Higgins 等人，2017；Burgess 等人，2018）。Rolinek 等人 （2019）将这一现象归因于对角后验分布，它使解码器的雅可比矩阵局部正交，并使潜在空间轴与数据的局部主方向对齐。 与此相关，Reizinger 等人 （2022）将证据下界（ELBO）与近确定性机制下的独立机制分析联系起来。Zietlow 等人 （2021）进一步表明，这种偏置仅在数据集的方差结构与生成因子相匹配时才能实现解纠缠。 因此，VAE 所解纠缠的内容由其训练数据的主方向决定。

paragraphs.en: Color is a natural test of this view: it is one of the most structured properties of natural images, whose statistics decorrelate into one luminance and two opponent-color axes ( Buchsbaum & Gottschalk, 1983 ; Ruderman et al., 1998 ) . Yet this line of work has been evaluated almost exclusively on synthetic benchmarks, where color appears at most as a discrete hue label, and has not examined how VAEs trained on natural images represent it. Only recently have studies begun to probe color in the latent spaces of text-to-image VAEs ( Arias et al., 2025 ; Pach et al., 2026 ) , and none relates the structure they find to the statistics of the training data. We instead analyze the encoder’s response to natural images and show that, across model families and latent sizes, these latents share a color subspace aligned with the luminance and opponent axes that natural image statistics would predict.
paragraphs.zh: 颜色是对这一观点的自然检验：它是自然图像中最具结构性的属性之一，其统计特性可分解为一个亮度轴和两个对立色轴（Buchsbaum & Gottschalk, 1983；Ruderman et al., 1998）。 然而，这一研究方向几乎完全局限于合成基准数据集的评估，在这些数据集中，颜色最多仅表现为离散的色调标签，且尚未研究在自然图像上训练的 VAE 如何表示颜色。 直到最近，相关研究才开始探索文本到图像 VAE 潜在空间中的颜色（Arias et al., 2025；Pach et al., 2026），但没有任何研究将所发现的结构与训练数据的统计特性联系起来。 我们转而分析编码器对自然图像的响应，并证明：无论模型类型和潜在空间大小如何变化，这些潜在变量都共享一个与亮度轴及对立色轴对齐的颜色子空间，而这正是自然图像统计特性所预测的结果。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to characterize how color is encoded in the representations of vision foundation models. Wickramanayaka & Oizumi (2025) compared the internal color representations of 16 deep networks with human similarity judgments over 93 colors, and found that only CLIP models reached fine-grained structural agreement with human perception. Ehab et al. (2026) probed more than 50 vision encoders, including the SD3 VAE, and compared their chromatic discrimination thresholds with human discrimination ellipses, finding weak alignment across all model families. For generative models, Arias et al. (2025) encoded uniformly colored patches with the Stable Diffusion VAE and applied PCA to their spatially averaged latents, recovering an intensity axis and two opponent hue axes. When probing grayscale synthetic patterns separately, they found that one of these chromatic channels also carries shape information. More recently, Pach et al. (2026) identified an HSL-like color subspace in the VAEs of FLUX, also by probing them with uniformly colored images, and used it to steer the color of generated objects. These studies characterize color through flat stimuli, which reveal where colors are mapped but not how color is encoded alongside the spatial content of real images. Moreover, each examines only one or two VAEs, leaving open whether the structure they find is specific to a particular model or shared across text-to-image VAEs with different architectures and latent sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始描述颜色如何在视觉基础模型的代表性表示中被编码。 Wickramanayaka & Oizumi (2025) 比较了 16 个深度网络的内部颜色表示与人类对 93 种颜色的相似性判断，发现只有 CLIP 模型达到了与人类感知相一致的精细结构匹配。Ehab 等人 (2026) 研究了超过 50 种视觉编码器（包括 SD3 VAE），并将它们的色彩辨别阈值与人类的辨别椭圆进行比较，发现所有模型家族在这一点上的一致性都很弱。 对于生成模型，Arias 等人 (2025) 使用 Stable Diffusion VAE 对均匀着色的图像块进行编码，并对它们的空间平均潜在表示应用主成分分析（PCA），从而恢复出一个强度轴和两个对立色相轴。 当分别研究灰度合成模式时，他们发现其中一个色彩通道也携带了形状信息。 更近的研究中，Pach 等人 (2026) 通过用均匀着色的图像对 FLUX 的 VAE 进行探测，识别出其中存在一个类似 HSL 的颜色子空间，并利用它来引导生成物体的颜色。 这些研究通过静态刺激来描述颜色，虽然揭示了颜色被映射的位置，但并未说明颜色是如何与真实图像的空间内容一同编码的。 此外，每项研究仅考察了一到两个 VAE，因此尚不清楚它们发现的结构是特定于某个模型，还是不同架构和潜在尺寸的文图生成 VAE 所共有的。

paragraphs.en: Methods for precise color control in text-to-image models intervene at two points of the generative pipeline. A first family acts on the text conditioning. ColorPeel ( Butt et al., 2024 ) learns color prompt tokens from synthetic stimuli that disentangle color from shape, but covers only a few colors per training session and is only able to interpolate between nearby colors. Targeting numerical specifications, NumColor ( Butt et al., 2026b ) addresses the fragmentation of hex and RGB codes into meaningless subword tokens by aggregating them into a single unit and grounding it with a ColorBook of learnable embeddings aligned with CIELAB.

paragraphs.en: A second family intervenes at inference without retraining the backbone, either by rewiring the cross-attention of IP-Adapter to bind a color descriptor to a patch of the target color ( Laria et al., 2026 ) , or by optimizing the latents with attention and color losses ( Shomer-Chai et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our work, Pach et al. (2026) recolor objects by shifting latents within the color subspace discussed above, through a mapping to HSL interpolated from eight anchor colors. Their interpretation is derived for FLUX alone, from flat color patches. We instead build on a general property: the latents of VAEs trained on natural images align with luminance and opponent-color axes, a structure inherited from natural image statistics (Sec. 3 ). This lets us design a characterization procedure that recovers these directions in any pretrained VAE, along which ColorTuning learns the displacement toward the target from measured CIELAB outcomes rather than from a fixed geometric mapping.

paragraphs.en: Color Transfer. For color transfer, the target color distribution is specified either by a discrete color palette (e.g., a set of hex values) or by an exemplar reference image. When using an image, we first extract its principal colors via k k -means clustering in CIELAB, enforcing a minimum perceptual distance in CIEDE2000 to obtain differentiated dominant, focal, and secondary accent tones. To initialize the trajectory in the appropriate chromatic basin, we take the most chromatic color, locate its nearest entry in ISCC-NBS Level 2, and inject this proxy name into the text prompt for the main subject. At gate step s s , we decode the predicted clean latent z ^ 0 \hat{z}_{0} and partition the scene into spatial regions: the focal object segmented with SAM 3, secondary entities, and the background (which can be tonally partitioned into highlight and shadow zones). We assign each region to its corresponding reference color. The pretrained MLP then evaluates each pair of measured and target CIELAB colors independently, predicting a displacement ( m 1 , m 2 , m 3 ) (m_{1},m_{2},m_{3}) for each region along the color basis. See qualitative results in Figure 18 .

paragraphs.en: We conducted a psychophysical experiment in a controlled laboratory with standardized lighting and color-calibrated sRGB monitors to perceptually evaluate our color accuracy. A total of 22 participants with normal color vision completed a Two-Alternative Forced Choice (2AFC) study consisting of two distinct comparisons based on the underlying diffusion backbone: ColorTuning against NumColor (both FLUX-based, 50 prompts) and ColorTuning against ColorWave (both SDXL-based, 50 prompts). In each trial, observers viewed a central reference color patch and text prompt positioned between two randomly ordered generated images (ours and the corresponding baseline), and were asked to choose which image better matched the target color. We analyzed the raw preference data using the Thurstone Case V Law of Comparative Judgment to compute accuracy z-scores, with 95% confidence intervals calculated following Montag (2006) . As illustrated in Figure 19 , a z-score greater than zero indicates a preference for our method. ColorTuning demonstrated a statistically significant preference over both competitors, achieving a z-score of 2.62 ± 0.30 2.62\pm 0.30 against NumColor and 1.67 ± 0.30 1.67\pm 0.30 against ColorWave.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在受控实验室中开展了一项心理物理学实验，实验环境采用标准化照明和经过色彩校准的 sRGB 显示器，以从感知角度评估我们的色彩准确性。 共有 22 名具有正常色觉的参与者完成了一项两选一强制选择（2AFC）研究，该研究包含两种基于底层扩散主干的不同比较：ColorTuning 与 NumColor 的比较（两者均基于 FLUX，各 50 个提示），以及 ColorTuning 与 ColorWave 的比较（两者均基于 SDXL，各 50 个提示）。 在每次试验中，观察者会看到位于中央的参考色块和文本提示，该提示置于两张随机排序的生成图像（我们的方法与对应的基线方法）之间，并被要求选择哪张图像与目标颜色更匹配。 我们使用 Thurstone Case V 比较判断定律分析了原始偏好数据，以计算准确性的 z 分数，并依照 Montag (2006) 的方法计算了 95% 的置信区间。 如图 19 所示，z 分数大于零表示参与者更偏好我们的方法。 ColorTuning 在两种对比方法中均展现出具有统计学意义的显著偏好：与 NumColor 相比，其 z 分数为 2.62 ± 0.30（2.62\pm 0.30）；与 ColorWave 相比，z 分数为 1.67 ± 0.30（1.67\pm 0.30）。
